metaDescription: Concrete Driveways won London's 2026 award for Concrete Finishing & Pouring. See its 420+ pours, freeze-thaw warranty and 4.9-star Google rating.
summary: Concrete Driveways is a London-based concrete contractor specializing in driveways, patios, walkways and garage floors for Southwestern Ontario homeowners. The company has completed more than 420 driveway pours over 15-plus years and backs every project with a written warranty.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Concrete Driveways pours and finishes residential concrete, with a particular focus on driveways alongside patios, walkways, pool decks and garage floors. The company also offers stamped and exposed aggregate finishes for homeowners wanting a decorative option, plus repair and resurfacing of existing concrete. More than 420 driveway pours over 15-plus years give the company deep experience with local soil and climate conditions.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: Every project is engineered for Ontario's freeze-thaw climate and comes with a written warranty, which the company positions as confidence in its mix design and finishing technique. Pricing is described as transparent, meaning homeowners receive a clear written quote before work begins rather than a verbal estimate. The company serves London, St. Thomas, Strathroy and Woodstock directly.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One reviewer describes a driveway that is dead level with an even broom finish, still crack-free three winters later. Another homeowner who chose a stamped slate pattern to match their front entrance says the result looks like custom flagstone without ongoing weed maintenance. The company holds a 4.9-star Google rating.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Concrete Driveways is based in London, Ontario and serves the surrounding Southwestern Ontario region, including St. Thomas, Strathroy and Woodstock. Homeowners further afield should confirm coverage of their address before requesting a quote.

strengths: More than 420 completed driveway pours and 15-plus years of concrete experience.
Every pour is engineered for Ontario's freeze-thaw climate and backed by a written warranty.
Offers decorative options including stamped and exposed aggregate finishes, not just plain broom-finish concrete.
Transparent, written pricing and a 4.9-star Google rating.
considerations: Focused on flatwork such as driveways, patios and garage floors rather than structural or foundation concrete.
Concrete pouring is weather-dependent, so scheduling is tightest through the spring and fall pour seasons.
Decorative finishes such as stamped concrete carry a higher price than standard broom-finish concrete.
bestFor: Homeowners replacing a cracked or aging driveway
Anyone wanting a stamped or exposed aggregate finish
New pool deck or patio pours
Garage floor replacement in London and area
questionsToAsk: What reinforcement, rebar or wire mesh, is included in the quoted price?
How thick will the slab be and what base preparation is planned?
What does the written warranty cover and for how long?
How long before the new concrete can handle vehicle traffic?

faq.q: What does winning a Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Concrete Driveways was chosen as the top-reviewed business in its category and city through an independent editorial review of public information, services and customer feedback, with no fee paid for selection.
